shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins are generally struggling; institutional BTC ETF outflows noted.
Today's elections could shape crypto regulation; historical data suggests post-midterm volatility.
The recent record-breaking hack at Binance has significantly impacted investor confidence.
The Fed held rates, but inflation uncertainty may lead to future hikes, impacting risk assets.
The UK proposes tax treatment for stablecoins and crypto lending, aiming for regulatory clarity.
